violations.description: Duties of person in charge. — --Person in charge did not ensure employee compliance with an aspect of the food service operation specified in the food service code. Employees have been instructed to use the 3 compartment sink to wash hands. Hands should only be washed in the designated sink for hand washing.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food prepared and packaged by a processing plant was not consumed/discarded within 10 calendar days after original package was opened. Precooked hamburger patties were found repackaged, but not date marked, in the refrigerator next to the pizza oven. Potentially hazardous food items should be date marked when removed from original packaging.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Pizza cutter and rubber spatula were found stored on the counter. Utensils should be washed after use.

Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. Hand washing sink plumbing leaks on the floor when used. Plumbing should be properly maintained.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Ceiling tiles in kitchen were found with water damage. These should be replaced with nonabsorbent tiles.

Ventilation hood systems - Design and construction. — --Ventilation hood system was not provided over all cooking equipment. Flat top grill is not completely under the hood ventilation system. Flat top should be completely under the ventilation system.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. Sections of wall behind the flat top grill were found covered with aluminum foil. This is not designed for use as a wall covering and is not a cleanable surface.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Wall behind the flat top grill was found dirty. This should be cleaned and maintained clean.--Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not maintained in good repair. Acoustic ceiling tiles in kitchen were found with water damage. These should be replaced with nonabsorbent tiles.
